body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Nokia presented its latest CDMA device 'Nokia 1006' for AWS carriers during 2009 CES.

Ergonomically designed for on-the-go convenience, the Nokia 1006 is curved to comfortably fit a user's face and hand, with a large, bright color display, and includes features like voice memo, speakerphone and a phonebook capable of holding 500 entries. The sleek device will be available in blue and silver.
